CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Do.en: You don't have space for this!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Do.fr: Tu n'as pas de place pour ça !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.en: TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof special attacks by your foe.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.fr: La CT16 contient MUR LUMIÈRE.\pCette capacité réduit la puissance\ndes attaques spéciales adverses.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.en: TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.\pIt's a move that prevents status\nproblems among your POKéMON.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.fr: La CT20 contient RUNE PROTECT.\pCette capacité protège ton équipe\ndes problèmes de statut.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.en: TM33 contains REFLECT.\pIt's a move that weakens the power\nof physical attacks by your foe.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex.fr: La CT33 contient PROTECTION.\pCette capacité réduit la puissance\ndes attaques physiques adverses.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.en: No, thank you!\nI'm not thirsty after all!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.fr: Non merci !\nFinalement, je n'ai pas soif !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.en: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!\p{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.fr: J'ai soif !\nJe veux quelque chose à boire !\p{FONT_NORMAL}Lui donner à boire ?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.en: I'm thirsty!\nI want something to drink!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im.fr: J'ai soif !\nJe veux quelque chose à boire !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_My.en: My sister is a TRAINER, believe it\nor not.\pBut, she's so immature, she drives\nme nuts!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_My.fr: Ma sœur est DRESSEUSE, je le jure.\pMais elle est si immature qu'elle\nme rend dingue !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_No.en: There's no more room for stuff!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_No.fr: Il n'y a plus de place pour\nd'autres objets !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ve.en: A vending machine!\nWhat does it have?

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.en: Yay!\pFRESH WATER!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.fr: Youpi !\pEAU FRAÎCHE !\pMerci !\nTu peux avoir ça de ma part !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.en: Yay!\pLEMONADE!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.fr: Youpi !\pLIMONADE !\pMerci !\nTu peux avoir ça de ma part !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.en: Yay!\pSODA POP!\pThank you!\nYou can have this from me!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya.fr: Youpi !\pSODA COOL !\pMerci !\nTu peux avoir ça de ma part !
